680101.Desc: Grants the ability to slowly ascend in mid-air. <style="accent-gn">Hold the jump button while jumping to enter ascend state, which continuously consumes Stamina until canceled.</style>
680101.Name: Air Dance

680201.Desc:
Grants the ability to leap forward with a special move.
After landing, a Timing Gauge appears. Jumping again at the right moment will build Stamina recovery progress; when full, Stamina is greatly restored.
680201.Name: Horizontal Jump

680401.Desc: Grants the ability to wall-kick upward. When near a wall, kicking propels the user upward, consuming Stamina with each jump.
680401.Name: Wall Jump

680501.Desc:
Grants the ability to run on walls.
Running slowly consumes Stamina, while standing still enters a wall-hang state that consumes no Stamina.
680501.Name: Wall Run

680701.Desc: Grants the ability to automatically vault certain obstacles without consuming Stamina.
680701.Name: Auto-Vault

682501.BuffName: 跳跃次数+1 3段跳 免疫坠落
682501.Desc:
Mid-air jump +1, consumes stamina, maximum 3 jumps.
Grants immunity to fall damage.
682501.Name: Multi-Jump

682503.Desc: Mid-air jump +1, consumes stamina, maximum 4 jumps.
682503.Name: Multi-Jump

682505.Desc: Mid-air jump +1, consumes stamina, maximum 5 jumps.
682505.Name: Multi-Jump
